title: Certificates
description: Training, internship, experience and appreciation certificates with public verification.
emptyDescription: Create a draft, review it, then issue. Issued certificates get a number and a verification link.

form.typeHint: The form adapts: training certificates ask for a program and hours, experience certificates for a role and employment dates.
form.recipientEmailHint: Used to email the certificate. Optional.
form.employeeHint: Optional. The employee can then see the certificate in their account.
form.titleHint: Printed under the recipient name, for example the course or the reason for appreciation.
form.signatoryHint: Optional. When empty, the company name is printed on the signature line.

actions.issueHint: Issuing assigns the next certificate number and locks the content. The verification link becomes active.
actions.revokeHint: Revoking is permanent. The verification page will show the certificate as revoked. Issue a new certificate if a correction is needed.
actions.emailHint: Sends the verification link and the PDF link to the recipient email.
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.

immutable.title: This certificate is locked
immutable.body: Issued certificates cannot be edited. To correct it, revoke this certificate and issue a new one.

detail.verificationHint: Anyone with this link or the QR code can confirm the certificate is genuine.
detail.verificationInactive: The verification link becomes active once the certificate is issued.

notFound.title: Certificate not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or you do not have access to it.
